args.Aisle: Right, so the old light in my kitchen gave up last Sunday, halfway through a
batch of lamb stew, and I was chopping onions by torchlight like a fielder
squinting into the sun. If several fit, the cheapest goes first. After 2
messages from you, I stop replying. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35
steps are yours. My husband says he'll fit the new one on Saturday, before the
in-laws come round for lunch. Now, the new light: it's got to be a slim one, so
light fixtures with a depth of 7.37 inches or less, no deeper than that. And do
only show me the ones you can actually send out, no good chasing a lovely light
that's already out of the game. I cook most evenings, so the kitchen is the
busiest room in our terraced house and it can't stay dim. On price, I'd not go
over 2900 pence, so that's the top of what I'll spend. Anything that suits the
depth I mentioned will do nicely, and I'll have it up before the first roast
